html:
As Christmas approaches, we find ourselves pausing to reflect on the remarkable journey of this past year. The FYI Yachts family is deeply moved by the blessings of 2025, from many new friends who trusted us with their nautical dreams to the dedicated team members whose hard work and care bring those dreams to life. This season of joy serves as a powerful reminder of the bonds we’ve built and the grace that has guided our path.

On that first holy night, the Bible tells us of the angel who appeared to the shepherds, calming their hearts with the words: “Fear not, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people” (Luke 2:10). This is the heartbeat of the season, the glorious reality that God sent His Son to offer us salvation and light. Christmas is more than a tradition; it is a celebration of the Greatest Gift ever given.

As we gather with loved ones, we hold close the promise of Romans 15:13:

“May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in faith so that you overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.”

To our cherished clients: thank you for making us a part of your story this year. To those who took delivery of a new vessel in 2025, we wish you a Christmas filled with the serenity that only time on the water and the presence of family can provide.

To our incredible team: your commitment is the anchor of FYI Yachts. Your passion for service reflects the spirit of this season, and we are profoundly grateful for your hard work and heart.

Whether you are looking to embark on a new chapter or find a new home for your current boat, know that our doors and hearts remain open to guide you. We are honored to serve you with expert care and a shared vision for the future.

From our family to yours, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a New Year overflowing with hope and grace. May your holidays be peaceful, and may the year ahead bring you smooth seas and horizons filled with God’s blessings.
